turn: Work has been heavy this week and I haven't slept properly.
I keep meaning to call my sister back but I never do.
It's been one of those stretches where everything piles up at once, the work deadlines, my father's appointments, the house, and I haven't had a single evening to myself in about three weeks.
I thought moving would fix it but I've been here four months now and I still feel like I'm waiting for my actual life to start, and I don't know who to say that to without sounding ungrateful.
इन दिनों नींद नहीं आती और मन बहुत भारी रहता है।
Office mein bahut pressure hai aur ghar pe bhi kaam bahut hai.
